answer: Because the timing is written down against the voyage challenge, the onyx audit can replay the garden history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 53 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1147 identities would post 4447 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
